name: Corn wine
summary: Rượu ngô is the northern kitchen’s corn wine. The yeast uses more than 20 forest leaves, and the corn rests about a month before it is distilled. A strength and a price are Check on arrival.
howToEat: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023: a yeast cake of more than 20 forest leaves, steamed corn mixed with the yeast and rested about a month, then distilled. The paper calls a modest pour a restorative. A strength is Check on arrival.
Drink it with a northern meal, in the evening. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Northern-route villages, at a meal, on the 22 March 2023 article.
